title: KAITO — Facing Your Song〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which song should I practice today...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This one's good...
Oh, so is this one...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? A sparrow?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did it stop by to listen to me play...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since it's come all this way, I should try playing something that it might like...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wh-What's wrong?
You both seem very anxious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There's something we need to ask you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My opinion about your song...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes. I was able to write a really good song thanks to you and Len, but we started disagreeing about this while we were cleaning it up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Both ideas have their merits, but I became lost in terms of which is better after giving it some thought.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's why she wants to know what we think!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Especially since you and Len gave her advice regarding how to write this song, KAITO. It makes sense to ask you, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please, I really want to hear your opinion!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
If my word means that much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I know it's a normal occurrence, but these two always seem to be able to do so much so fast... I honestly can't keep up with them...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still, I'm glad she asked since I was wondering what happened to her song after she completed the rough draft for it...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start by playing the first version!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Okay, she said they're in disagreement about the third verse and the pre-chorus...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(It really is a nice song...
You can clearly tell what was going through Saki's mind.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Sh-She's staring right at me...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But that pre-chorus is coming up. I need to focus...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Sakki, you probably shouldn't stare so hard at KAITO like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But I really wanna hear which melody he likes more...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but you're gonna make him feel really uncomfortable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
R-Right...
Okay... As much as I want to hear what you think, I'll do my best not to stare...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I feel a little better now... I think?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Anyway, I need to focus on the music...)
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: ...is my opinion.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you think? Does it help...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, your explanation made so much sense! I'll let Ichi and the girls know right away!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. The thing is, I also prefer the melody that you chose, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm sure everyone will agree after I tell them that you felt the same way!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A-Are you sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, I'm very confident!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll be right back after telling the others what you said. Thank you for listening, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You too, Rin! Thanks for lending me a hand!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I appreciate what Saki said, but my opinion's no more valuable than anybody else's...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm really not sure that it'll be enough to convince the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
I mean, you're KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Well, you exude this aura...
Like you know the most about music out of all of us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: An aura...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, a musical one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I don't quite understand...
But I'm glad that I'm able to help.)
